messages:
aya: Heads up — multiple SAST failures showing up on service-packaging CI. Failing pre-merge on a bunch of unrelated files.

aya: Short log snippet:
```shell
2026-06-14T12:02:11Z ERROR scanner: artifact decrypt failed
aws_kms.DecryptException: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-scanner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ab12-cd34-ef56
    at /build/ci/scanner/main.go:142
```

ben: Is that the new RBAC tightening that went out this morning? I saw a policy update PR (#4123) for the packaging team.

nina: Yes, packaging team rolled a narrower KMS policy to stop wide decrypt perms. I pinged them earlier about limiting `iam:PassRole` but didn't expect scanner to be affected.

matt: @nina can you paste the policy change? If scanner can't Decrypt we get false positives because it can't load compiled dependencies.

nina: policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/packaging-deployer"}}
}
```

sec-bot: Audit log shows repeated kms:Decrypt DENY entries from ci-scanner at 12:01: test run id=ci/pack-1987

sec-bot: Example audit event: `principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-scanner action=kms:Decrypt resource=key/ab12-cd34 result=AccessDenied`

aya: That explains it. So scanner can't fetch encrypted artifacts; SAST then falls back to scanning source-only output and flags a ton of `missing-deps` style issues.

ben: Quick mitigation idea: grant a scoped, time-limited KMS grant specifically to ci-scanner for the packaging key, and add the scanner worker to allowlist. We should avoid a broad rollback.

matt: Agreed. Also update the SAST runner to treat decrypt errors as diagnostic-only (reduce noise) for a short window while we fix infra. We can annotate findings as `triage:requires-artifact` so they don't block merges.

nina: I'll open infra ticket to create an ephemeral grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id ab12-cd34 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-scanner --operations Decrypt --name "ci-scanner-temp"` and set a 4h auto-revoke reminder.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1287 — ephemeral grant + audit proofing. ETA: 30m. Assigned to @nina.

aya: In parallel I'm going to add a temporary scanner suppression file for the packaging repo so pre-merge doesn't block: `.sast/suppressions/packaging-temp.yaml` with matcher for `missing-deps` and note linking INFRA-1287.

ben: Please make that suppression very explicit and expire automatically. Add a required follow-up to remove suppression after the grant is revoked.

matt: Also, long-term we'd prefer the scanner use a KMS key specifically provisioned for CI scanning, with least privilege key policy and dedicated service account. Open a design doc? I'll volunteer to sketch it.

nina: Filing RFC: SEC-RFC-2026-01 "ci-scanner key lifecycle + ephemeral grants". Will include options: per-repo CI key, centralized read-only scan key, or artifact signing + public verification.

aya: Quick checklist for now:
- nina: create ephemeral grant (INFRA-1287)
- aya: add suppression + include audit ticket in PR
- matt: write draft RFC and link it
- ben: update SAST runner to mark decrypt-failure findings non-blocking

sec-bot: Noted. Adding audit tags: `investigation=kms-decrypt-deny, blocker=false` to INFRA-1287.

nina: Grant created and deployed, CI run re-triggered — scans are back to normal in the last build. Will schedule revoke at +4h.

aya: Verified — failing SAST counts dropped from 42 -> 3. Those 3 are real. Thanks everyone :tada:

ben: After revoke we should replay the failing builds from the window and confirm no regressions. Add to INFRA-1287 acceptance criteria.

matt: I'll add the replay step and the RFC link. Let's also record the KMS audit entry IDs for postmortem.

nina: Putting audit IDs in the ticket now. Will follow up with patch to packaging policy to explicitly allow the scanner principal for Decrypt on artifacts only.

aya: Great. If anyone sees more odd SAST noise, ping me in this thread.

infra-bot: INFRA-1287 updated: ephemeral grant revoked at 2026-06-14T16:05:00Z, replayed builds OK.

sec-bot: Closing investigation label; follow-ups: SEC-RFC-2026-01, INFRA-1287, SAST-PR-401 to revert suppression.
